title: Fewer Bits, More Tries: Recovering Capability Under Memory Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.15372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are generally more capable than smaller ones, but their memory requirements can make local deployment difficult. We ask whether part of this capability gap can instead be recovered by running a smaller or more compressed model multiple times and selecting among its outputs using public or model-generated tests. Single-user local inference can leave hardware underutilized, allowing parallel candidate generation to trade additional test-time computation for accuracy at modest latency cost. Across four code-generation benchmarks, verified retry recovers substantial accuracy lost to model size or compression. A 7B Qwen model with eight parallel attempts essentially matches a 32B model on MBPP+ and exceeds it on the other three benchmarks, while using about $4\times$ less model memory, running up to $6\times$ faster, and using less energy, as measured on Nvidia GPU. translated_title: 更少比特，更多尝试：在内存约束下恢复模型能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型通常比小模型能力更强，但其内存需求使得本地部署变得困难。我们探究是否可以通过多次运行一个更小或更压缩的模型，并使用公开的或模型生成的测试来筛选其输出，从而弥补部分能力差距。单用户本地推理往往导致硬件利用率不足，这使得并行生成候选结果成为可能——以额外的测试时计算换取准确率提升，同时延迟成本适中。在四个代码生成基准测试上，经过验证的重试方法恢复了因模型规模缩小或压缩而损失的大量准确率。一个7B的Qwen模型进行八次并行尝试后，在MBPP+上基本与32B模型持平，并在其他三个基准上超越它，同时模型内存占用减少约4倍，运行速度最高提升6倍，且经Nvidia GPU实测能耗更低。我们在模型规模和压缩程度方面均观察到类似的权衡规律。
tldr: 该论文提出在内存受限场景下，通过多次运行更小或更压缩的模型并利用测试验证来筛选输出，能够恢复大部分因模型规模缩小或压缩而损失的能力，使7B模型在代码生成任务上匹敌甚至超越32B模型。
